name: Disneyland Carnation Café Mickey-Shaped Waffle or Buttermilk Pancakes with Scrambled Eggs
brandOrRestaurant: Carnation Café (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Golden Mickey waffle or fluffy buttermilk pancakes paired with two scrambled eggs and turkey/pork bacon gives you a relaxed table-service breakfast with zero roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Mickey-Shaped Waffle with scrambled eggs and maple syrup (skip the seeded berry compote topping; allergy-friendly dairy-free waffles available on request).
watchOuts: Ask for maple syrup instead of spiced apple or seeded berry toppings
